newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys 400,000 tonnes soft red U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 400,000 tonnes soft red U.S. wheat.

text.p: Egypt bought 400,000 tonnes of soft red U.S. wheat at $143.40 per tonne for delivery in June and July, the country's official in charge of commodities buying said on Wednesday.
Samir Shakankiri, vice-chairman of the General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC), told Reuters the prices for each of the eight shipments were $143.40 and f.o.b.
He gave the following details about the shipments-
- 50,000 tonnes from Cargill for loading June 20 to July 5.
- 50,000 tonnes from Cargill for loading July 10 to July 29.
- 50,000 tonnes from Continental for loading July 5 to July 15.
- 50,000 tonnes from Continental for loading July 15 to July 25.
- 50,000 tonnes from Continental loading July 20 to July 28.
- 50,000 tonnes from Mitsubishi loading July 5 to July 20.
- 50,000 tonnes from Dreyfuss loading July 1 to July 20.
- 50,000 tonnes from Dreyfuss loading beginning of July to July 20.

Shakankiri said that all of the traders must submit a freight offer to the Egyptian shipping company Martrans on Friday, May 30, and it must be valid for 72 hours from that date. A copy must also be sent to GASC.
